select_from_where.doc: SELECT … FROM … WHERE — basic single-table query template.

select_group_having.doc: SELECT … GROUP BY … HAVING — aggregation with a post-filter.

inner_join.doc: INNER JOIN … ON — standard equijoin between two tables.

left_join.doc: LEFT JOIN … ON — keep all rows from the left side, NULL on the right when no match.

insert_into.doc: INSERT INTO … VALUES — single-row insert template.

update_set_where.doc: UPDATE … SET … WHERE — guarded update template; never omit the WHERE.

create_table.doc: CREATE TABLE — basic table with a BIGSERIAL primary key.

create_index.doc: CREATE INDEX — single-column B-tree index template.

cte.doc: WITH name AS (…) — common table expression skeleton.

cte_recursive.doc: WITH RECURSIVE — base + step + JOIN tree-walk pattern.

window_row_number.doc: ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION … ORDER BY …) — sequence within partition.

window_lag.doc: LAG(col) OVER (…) — value of a previous row in the partition.

jsonb_get.doc: col->>'key' — extract a text value from jsonb.

case_when.doc: CASE WHEN … THEN … ELSE … END — conditional expression.

union_all.doc: UNION ALL — concatenate rows; faster than UNION (no dedupe).

truncate.doc: TRUNCATE TABLE … RESTART IDENTITY CASCADE — fast wipe with FK cascade.

count.doc: Count rows. count(*) counts all; count(expr) counts non-NULL.

array_agg.doc: Aggregate input values into an array.

string_agg.doc: Concatenate input values with a delimiter.

jsonb_agg.doc: Aggregate values into a jsonb array.

jsonb_object_agg.doc: Aggregate key/value pairs into a jsonb object.

bool_and.doc: True when every input is true.

bool_or.doc: True when at least one input is true.

rank.doc: Rank within partition; gaps for ties.

dense_rank.doc: Rank within partition; no gaps for ties.

lag.doc: Value of a previous row in the partition.

lead.doc: Value of a following row in the partition.

first_value.doc: Value of the first row in the window frame.

last_value.doc: Value of the last row in the window frame.

nth_value.doc: Value of the Nth row in the window frame.

length.doc: Number of characters in a text value.

replace.doc: Replace all occurrences of a substring.

split_part.doc: Split on delimiter and return the Nth piece.

regexp_matches.doc: Return matched groups as a text array.

age.doc: Difference between two timestamps as an interval.

date_trunc.doc: Truncate a timestamp to a field (year, month, day…).

extract.doc: Extract a field (year, month, dow…) from a date/time.

to_char.doc: Format a value as text using the given format pattern.

to_date.doc: Parse text into a date using the given format.

to_timestamp.doc: Parse text into a timestamp using the given format.

make_timestamp.doc: Build a timestamp from numeric components.

round.doc: Round to the nearest integer or N places.

jsonb_build_object.doc: Build a jsonb object from alternating key/value args.

jsonb_build_array.doc: Build a jsonb array from the args.

jsonb_set.doc: Replace or insert a value at a path inside a jsonb document.

jsonb_strip_nulls.doc: Remove keys whose value is null from a jsonb object.

jsonb_object_keys.doc: Return the top-level keys of a jsonb object.

jsonb_typeof.doc: Return the type of a jsonb value as text.

jsonb_array_elements.doc: Expand a jsonb array into a set of jsonb values.

jsonb_path_query.doc: Run a jsonpath query and return matching values.

array_length.doc: Length of a given array dimension.

array_position.doc: Index of an element within an array.

array_remove.doc: Remove all matching elements from an array.

array_replace.doc: Replace all matching elements in an array.

array_to_string.doc: Concatenate array elements into a single text.

nullif.doc: Return NULL when the two args are equal, else the first.

cast.doc: Convert a value to another type.

generate_series.doc: Generate a series of integers, dates, or timestamps.

pg_column_size.doc: Storage size of a value in bytes.

db_size.title: Database size
db_size.explanation: Total on-disk size of the current database via pg_database_size(). The 7-day sparkline tracks growth from snapshots taken when you open this Health tab.

bloat.title: Table bloat
bloat.explanation: Estimated dead-tuple percentage per table from a pure-SQL bloat heuristic (no pgstattuple required). Higher = more wasted space; consider VACUUM FULL or REINDEX.

slow_queries.title: Slow queries
slow_queries.explanation: Top queries from pg_stat_statements ordered by total execution time. Requires the pg_stat_statements extension.

missing_indexes.title: Possibly missing indexes
missing_indexes.explanation: Tables with high seq_scan-to-idx_scan ratios from pg_stat_user_tables — candidates for adding an index. Verify with EXPLAIN before acting.

unused_indexes.title: Unused indexes
unused_indexes.explanation: Indexes with zero scans since stats were last reset, excluding primary keys. Drop only after verifying the index isn't used by background jobs.

cache_hit.title: Cache hit ratio
cache_hit.explanation: Fraction of buffer reads served from shared_buffers. Below 95% suggests shared_buffers is too small or workload is scan-heavy.

active_connections.title: Active connections
active_connections.explanation: Current connections to this database vs max_connections. Monitor for connection-pool starvation; idle-in-transaction is a problem signal.

long_running.title: Long-running queries (>30s)
long_running.explanation: Active queries running for more than 30 seconds. Long-running transactions block VACUUM and prevent stats updates.

vacuum_status.title: Vacuum status
vacuum_status.explanation: Tables not vacuumed (manual or auto) in the last 7 days. Stale stats cause poor query plans; consider scheduling a manual VACUUM.

replication_lag.title: Replication lag
replication_lag.explanation: Replication slots and their byte/time lag from pg_replication_slots and pg_stat_replication. Requires pg_monitor role to read slot details.

wal_throughput.title: WAL throughput
wal_throughput.explanation: WAL write rate (average since pg_stat_wal stats_reset). Requires PostgreSQL 14+.

jsonb_index_suggestions.title: JSONB index suggestions
jsonb_index_suggestions.explanation: Top GIN index recommendations mined from pg_stat_statements JSONB operator patterns. Requires pg_stat_statements extension.
jsonb_index_suggestions.empty: No JSONB ops detected in pg_stat_statements
